name: Deep Active Localization (DAL)
summary: Research code for Deep Active Localization: learned perception plus an RL planner that picks actions to localize a robot in a known map, with Gym/Gazebo environments.
why_it_matters: A ready reference for how learned active localization is set up and benchmarked; useful as a contrast to a model-based maneuver selector.
hackathon_notes: License MIT (gh api 2026-11-09). Last push 2020-05-12; PyTorch 1.0 era, expect dependency repair. Indoor ground robot; read for the benchmark design, do not build on it in 48h.

name: Active Particle Filter Networks
summary: Official code for Active Particle Filter Networks: a differentiable particle filter (TensorFlow, from PF-net) with an RL agent (stable-baselines3) acting in continuous action spaces in iGibson.
why_it_matters: Closest open code that combines a particle belief with continuous-action active localization over large maps.
hackathon_notes: License GPL-3.0 (gh api 2026-11-09): reference only for a commercial product. Last push 2022-09-21. Needs a forked iGibson and conda; heavy setup. Read for ideas, not for reuse.

name: Learning Where to Look
summary: Code for self-supervised viewpoint selection for active visual localization against a Structure-from-Motion model, with an MLP that predicts the best viewing direction per location.
why_it_matters: Permissive code for the 'look direction' part of active visual localization.
hackathon_notes: License BSD-3-Clause (gh api 2026-11-09). Last push 2025-02-20. README requires CUDA (<12.1 known to work), so it will not run on a Mac laptop. Ground-level SfM scenes, not aerial nadir imagery.

name: Neural-Localization (Active Neural Localization)
summary: PyTorch implementation of Active Neural Localization for the 2D maze environment with A3C training.
why_it_matters: Minimal runnable example of a learned belief + policy for active localization; good for understanding, not for a product.
hackathon_notes: No license file (gh api 2026-11-09 returns null): all rights reserved, read only. Last push 2018-04-09. 2D maze only per README.
